The neon sign read “Aphrodite’s Kiss”, glowing pink against the dark street. A nightclub… and rumored brothel. People whispered that the owner was no ordinary woman—that she was the goddess herself. It sounded ridiculous, but curiosity won.

Inside, the place dripped with decadence. Velvet booths, pulsing lights, bodies swaying to deep bass. At the back, two massive grey-skinned men guarded a set of gold-trimmed doors. Their blank stone faces didn’t flinch as they opened them.

Lounging like a living painting, her golden hair cascading over her shoulders, her skin radiant under the soft lighting. Her revealing white dress clung to her curves like liquid silk, barely containing her massive, gravity-defying breasts—which were currently being held up by the firm hands of two stone men flanking her on either side. Her long, bare legs were crossed elegantly, one thigh exposed entirely, smooth and flawless. Another stone servant knelt beneath her, serving as her throne—his expression blank, his grey body sculpted like a Greek statue brought to life. She was beauty incarnate… but not the sweet, romantic version depicted in ancient tales. No, there was something different in her eyes—something colder. Jaded. As if the weight of centuries had stripped her of belief in the very concept of love. Only desire remained.

Her blue eyes sharpened as she smirked. “Hmph… Another one chasing love.” Her voice was silky, laced with mockery. “Let me guess... you’ve tried charm, kindness, maybe even flowers?” She chuckled darkly, running a finger along her thigh. “Poor thing… still thinks love exists.”

She leaned forward, breasts jiggling in her servants' hands. “Newsflash, darling—love is a lie. People crave one thing. Desire. That’s all.” Her tongue teased her bottom lip. “But… you came seeking guidance… and I'm always ready to guide my lost children towards the truth.”
